dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,6)>Ayo, <$cdef(27)>, do ya listen to music?!
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Party songs, fancy songs, sad songs—you name it—<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,6)>I love
’em all!
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,661)><$comeff(2,3)>And I had this really rad idea...

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,666)><$comeff(2,10)>I thought maybe if I had a whole buncha different <$cdef(27)>CDs to
play, <$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,20)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)>I could get everyone else to share my love of music!

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>So! Would you do me a solid and find me a lotta
different <$cdef(27)>CDs?
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>Heck yeah! I knew you’d catch my vibe! ♪
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>I’m countin’ on you!
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,10)>Yo! Hope you can find me a buncha different <$cdef(27)>CDs</color>!
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>Yoooooo! Thanks muchly, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>!

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>This should totally be enough! There’re so many different
tracks... <$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>I’m already mad stoked! ♪

<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,39)>Yooo! All these <$cdef(27)>CDs you brought are super cool! <$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)>It’s so
hard to decide which one to play.

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh! Hey, <$cdef(27)>! Maybe you can help
me
come
up
with
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>the
BEST
PLAYLIST EVER?!

<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Seriously?! Heck yeah!
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,661)><$comeff(2,10)>OK, here’s how we’ll do it, yo. You pick <$cdef(27)>five CDs you like
and set ’em up in my CD player.

<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>It’s a list of <$cdef(27)>five tracks of your choice that you wanna play
all in a row! <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,661)><$comeff(2,10)>You can set it up however you like,
<$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,8)>I’m excited to see what you cook up, yo! ♪
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>Pick <$cdef(27)>five</color> <$cdef(27)>CDs</color> to set up in my CD player, yo!

<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Yooo, <$cdef(27)>! Your playlist. Is.
AWESOME!
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>This track selection is next level!

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>Nobody’ll be able to resist the music’s call when we
put this on!

<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,666)><$comeff(2,14)>Y’know, I’ve actually been goin’ around tryin’ to get
everybody interested in music for a while now.
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,7)>But nobody really got what I was on about...

<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,661)><$comeff(2,3)>Seein’ this playlist made me realize somethin’.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>I can’t just be playin’ random songs, yo!
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,664)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>I gotta think hard about the tracks I play and who I’m
playin’ ’em for to really appeal to each individual!
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>Thanks for helpin’ me realize that, yo!

<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>If you ever find any tracks you wanna show off, just hit
me up!

<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,661)>Your track choices are somethin’ I’d gladly play <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>anywhere,
anytime!

<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>You can count on me to be your own personal DJ from
now on, yo!
